            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

prompt_enhancement.description: When set to true, enhances the provided prompt by generating additional, more descriptive variations, resulting in more diverse and creative output images.

image_url.description: The image that should be used as guidance, in base64 format, with the method defined in guidance_method_1. Accepted formats are jpeg, jpg, png, webp. Maximum file size 12MB. If more then one guidance method is used, all guidance images must be of the same aspect ratio, and this will be the aspect ratio of the generated results. If guidance_method_1 is selected, an image must be provided.

medium.description: Which medium should be included in your generated images. This parameter is optional.
